text: 此人不能告诉你什么。
source_text: 此人不能告诉你什么。

text: You see the Elder.
source_text: You see the Elder.

text: I am pleased to meet you. I hope you have found this little village pleasing so far.
source_text: I am pleased to meet you. I hope you have found this little village pleasing so far.

text: Yes.
source_text: Yes.

text: Nope, not enough action around here.
source_text: Nope, not enough action around here.

text: Excellent. I have a favor to ask of you. I promise that you will be well-rewarded for your services to this community.
source_text: Excellent. I have a favor to ask of you. I promise that you will be well-rewarded for your services to this community.

text: Tell me more . . .
source_text: Tell me more . . .

text: This is just a demo, but perhaps you will like what I have to say next.
source_text: This is just a demo, but perhaps you will like what I have to say next.

text: I'm all ears . . .
source_text: I'm all ears . . .

text: We have been plagued by Rad Scorpions for some time now. All who have been sent to destroy these monsters have not returned. I will give you weapons and armor if you will follow my guide to their lair and kill them all.
source_text: We have been plagued by Rad Scorpions for some time now. All who have been sent to destroy these monsters have not returned. I will give you weapons and armor if you will follow my guide to their lair and kill them all.

text: Sounds good.
source_text: Sounds good.

text: No thanks.
source_text: No thanks.

text: That is a shame. Please leave.
source_text: That is a shame. Please leave.

text: Excellent. Sammy here will guide you to the lair. Take these items - they will come in useful.
source_text: Excellent. Sammy here will guide you to the lair. Take these items - they will come in useful.

text: Please help us as soon as possible. Time is wasting.
source_text: Please help us as soon as possible. Time is wasting.

text: I don't talk to your kind, stranger.
source_text: I don't talk to your kind, stranger.

text: 你看到老人。
source_text: 你看到老人。

text: 很高兴见到你。希望这个小村子让你感觉宾至如归。
source_text: 很高兴见到你。希望这个小村子让你感觉宾至如归。

text: 是的。
source_text: 是的。

text: 不，这没啥活动空间。
source_text: 不，这没啥活动空间。

text: 好极了。我需要你帮个忙。而且我保证报酬会很丰厚的。
source_text: 好极了。我需要你帮个忙。而且我保证报酬会很丰厚的。

text: 告诉我更多。
source_text: 告诉我更多。

text: 闲言少述，或许你会喜欢我接下来要说的。
source_text: 闲言少述，或许你会喜欢我接下来要说的。

text: 洗耳恭听……
source_text: 洗耳恭听……

text: 那些变异蝎子像瘟疫一样缠着我们。派去消灭那些怪物的人一个没回来。如果你愿意和我的向导去把它们全干掉我就送你武器和装备。
source_text: 那些变异蝎子像瘟疫一样缠着我们。派去消灭那些怪物的人一个没回来。如果你愿意和我的向导去把它们全干掉我就送你武器和装备。

text: 听起来不错。
source_text: 听起来不错。

text: 不用了，谢谢。
source_text: 不用了，谢谢。

text: 真遗憾。请你离开吧。
source_text: 真遗憾。请你离开吧。

text: 太棒了。萨米会带你去蝎子窝。带上这些——你迟早会用到。
source_text: 太棒了。萨米会带你去蝎子窝。带上这些——你迟早会用到。

text: 请尽快帮助我们。别浪费时间。
source_text: 请尽快帮助我们。别浪费时间。

text: 我们没什么好谈的，陌生人。
source_text: 我们没什么好谈的，陌生人。
